第24章 嫂子，尝一尝肉包子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

隔壁桌！

来老屯和李大奎，李青山望着送来的包子和油条，眼珠子都要瞪出来了，不断咽着口水，急切的想要狼吞虎咽。

昨天晚上，李青山一家子吃肉的时候，竟然没分给他们一点。

实在是馋死了。

没想到今天早晨运气这么好，终于可以解馋了。

“老板娘，这肉包子和油条不是我们先点的吗？怎么给他们上了？”

李青山开口道。

“什么？”

“你们不是一起的吗？”

老板娘微微一怔，目光朝着李青山望了过去。

“不是，我们四个人是一起的，他们三个人是一起的！”李青山语气平静道。

“哦，原来是这样！”

老板娘将肉包子和油条放在李青山桌子上，然后看向李青书道：“同志，你要几个包子几个油条，先把钱付一下，我马上给你上来。”

“什么？”

隔壁桌的李青山和李大奎，异口同声，目光朝着李青山和老板娘看了过去，一时间有些不知道如何应对。

“哼！”

李老屯听到李青山的话后，顿时被气的不轻，差点脑溢血，手中的筷子狠狠拍在面前的桌子上，发出一道巨响。

原本就有些年久失修的桌子，竟然被李老屯一巴掌给拍碎了。

“干什么？干什么？”

“砸店啊？”

“你到底点不点肉包子？”

老板娘见状，脸上流露出一抹不悦道。

“那个，老板娘，我们就在这里坐一会，不吃……不吃……！”李大奎摆了摆手道。

在这里吃早点太贵了，还是回家吃便宜一些。

“不吃？”

“不吃把桌子钱给我赔了，两毛钱，快些！”老板娘望着李青书等人催促道。

“啥？”

“这一个桌子，要两毛钱？”

老板娘话音落下，李大奎顿时跳了出来道。

“咋地，不行啊？”

“今天这钱你们不给，就别想走了，全部送到公安那里去！”

早餐店的老板拎着菜刀走了出来，一副凶相毕露的模样，恶狠狠瞪着李大奎和李老屯道。

“爹，这桌子，是您拍碎的。”

“您看，你解决一下？”

李大奎皱了皱眉头，目光朝着自己老爹看了过去。

“哼！”

“不就是……不就是两毛钱吗……！”

李老屯望着那凶相毕露的老板，最终还是不敢在外人面前炸刺，毕竟桌子被拍碎，确实是自己干的。

只得将今天准备买肉的两毛钱拿出来，给了老板娘。

现在猪肉四毛钱一斤。

本来是打算买半斤回去解馋的，毕竟昨天晚上被李青山那一家子给馋的差点睡不着觉，却不曾想……！！

竟然发生这样的事情？

“许同志，你这天天吃豆腐可不行，你看你这身板，怎么这么瘦？”

“来，肉包子，多吃点！”

李青山不再去管隔壁桌的李老屯他们，而是拿起一个肉包子，塞给旁边的许晚吟后，便招呼着大壮二壮，还有自己老爹道：‘吃，都吃啊，别客气……！’

“哎！”

大壮和二壮点头，早已按耐不住内心的期待，连忙拿起肉包子便啃了起来。

李青山自然也不客气。

大口大口吃着，肉汁在口中迸开，鲜香无比，肉香更是朝着四周飘去。

隔壁桌。

一大早晨起来，赶路一个小时，什么都没吃的爷三，望着李青山这边吃的肉包子和油条，肚子开始咕噜噜叫了起来。

目光更是不断朝着李青山这边瞥过来。

香！！

是真香啊！！

这一刻，李青书和李大奎，宛若热锅上的蚂蚁，恨不得跑过来将肉包子抢了吃了。

“吃，让他们吃！”

“那点钱啊，早晚让他们败光，等到败光的时候，早晚会来求咱们的。”

李老屯开口道。

‘爹说得对，现在先让他们嚣张一阵子，早晚会来求咱们的。’李大奎爷郑重点头，对此坚信不疑。

李青书则是忍不住在心里骂娘。

老东西，闲的没事拍什么桌子，要不然这两毛钱，至少能把三个人的早餐对付过去吧？

大壮和二壮，以及老爹吃了六个包子，三根油条，五碗粥，实在是吃不下去了，肚子都鼓起来了。

这早点摊，实在是太实诚了，包子和油条都大。

许晚吟吃了一个包子，一碗粥，最后望着李青山递过来的油条，只好硬吃了下去。

现在正揉着肚子，一脸委屈的看着李青山。

至于剩下的四根油条，五个包子，两碗粥，李青山直接一个人全部解决。

大壮兄弟俩，还有老爹，包括许晚吟都看傻了。

这也太能吃了？

不过，能吃好啊，能吃是福气！！

“嗯，七分饱！”

李青山摸了摸肚子，开口道。

如今自己练养生拳后，每日都需要大量的食物补充能量，这都是包子皮和油条，都是碳水，蛋白质也不多，确实是七分饱。

待会打一套养生拳，消耗的差不多了。

隔壁桌的李大奎和李青书，正用能杀死人的眼神盯着李青山和李三奎。

“都吃饱了没有？”李青山开口问道。

“嗯，饱了！”

大壮等人点了点头道。

“老板娘，再来四个包子，四根油条！”李青山开口喊道。

“啥？”

“青山，你还没吃饱？”

李三奎脸上流露出一抹惊诧之色，上下打量着李青山道。

自家儿子以前，好像也没有这么能吃才对啊。

怎么这两日，吃的这么多？

“娘和嫂子在家还没得吃呢，给他们带回去一些。”李青山开口道。

“哦，这……这我倒是忘记了。”

李三奎挠了挠头，脸上闪过一抹尴尬之色。

“你这小同志，还挺孝顺呢！”老板娘很快将包子和油条包好了，给李青山递了过来道：“就是不知道，疼不疼媳妇嘞！！”

“咋了，老板娘家里可有什么妹妹？”

“要是有的话，给我介绍介绍，以后你就知道我疼不疼媳妇了。”

李青山笑着道。

“行！”

“等你下次来，我给你介绍！”

老板娘收了李青山得钱后，顺手又在李青山的手背上滑了过去，柔弱无骨，还有那一双娇媚的美眸朝着李青山再次一挑，依旧是令人心动。

娘的，小浪蹄子。

早晚给她办了。

李青山咽了口水道：“爹，现在乡政府还没开门，咱们先在这里坐着歇一歇吧！”

“嗯！”

李三奎点头应下。

李青山则是趁着这段空闲，去旁边空地上打了一套养生拳，龙筋虎猛，晨曦落在身上，胸口的小葫芦玉佩散发出淡淡的光辉，似乎在吸收晨曦的力量。

许晚吟本来打算歇一歇就离开的，毕竟吃的实在是太多了，有些撑得慌。

但是见到李青山一套拳法打的厉害，倒也忘记了去上班。

正在做早点的老板娘，目光也是朝着李青山望了过来，风韵的眼神中闪过一抹对年轻汉子身躯的渴望。

想到自家那口子，一到晚上便如死猪一般。

便心中泛起一抹幽怨。

这汉子，可真好啊……！！

打了一套养生拳后，李青山感觉肚子里的食也差不多消化了一些，便走了过来。

“青山同志，你刚刚打的是什么拳？好厉害？”许晚吟一双忧郁的双眸盯着李青山，此刻却闪烁着异样精光道。

“哦，随便练一练罢了！”李青山谦虚道。

“哎呀，坏了，我得赶紧去上班了。”就在这时，许晚吟突然想起了什么，连忙起身道。

“许姑娘在哪里上班，怎么去的这么早？”李青山好奇道。

现在才早晨六点钟，上班的时间也太早了吧？

“咱们土乡的供销社啊，我刚来，需要提前熟悉一下，所以才早点到的！”

“等到熟悉了后，就是七点半上班了。”

许晚吟开口道。

“原来你在供销社上班啊？”李青山微微一惊道。

“是啊！”

“怎么了？”

许晚吟点头道。

“我这还准备去供销社采购一些物资呢，不过供销社还没开门，就在这里等着了。”

李青山道。

“原来是这样！”

“今天你帮了我，我也帮你一次吧！”

“走吧，跟我去供销社！”

许晚吟开口道。

Next table!

When he came to Laotun and Li Dakui, Li Qingshan's eyes almost popped out when he looked at the steamed buns and fried dough sticks that were delivered to him. He kept swallowing and wanted to devour them eagerly.

Last night, when Li Qingshan's family ate meat, they didn't even get any.

I'm really greedy.

I didn't expect that I would be so lucky this morning, and I could finally satisfy my craving.

"Lady boss, didn't we order these meat buns and fried dough sticks first? Why did we serve them?"

Li Qingshan said.

"What?"

"Aren't you together?"

The landlady was slightly startled and looked towards Li Qingshan.

"No, the four of us are together, and the three of them are together!" Li Qingshan said calmly.

"Oh, so that's it!"

The proprietress placed the meat buns and fried dough sticks on Li Qingshan's table, then looked at Li Qingshan and said, "Comrade, if you want a few steamed buns and fried dough sticks, please pay first and I'll bring them to you right away."

"What?"

Li Qingshan and Li Dakui at the next table spoke in unison and looked at Li Qingshan and the proprietress. For a moment, they didn't know how to respond.

"Hmph!"

After Li Laotun heard what Li Qingshan said, he was so angry that he almost had a cerebral hemorrhage. He slapped the chopsticks in his hand on the table in front of him, making a loud noise.

The table, which was already in some disrepair, was smashed to pieces by Li Laotun.

"What? What?"

"Smashing the store?"

"Are you going to order meat buns or not?"

Seeing this, the landlady said with a hint of displeasure on her face.

"Well, boss lady, let's sit here for a while, if we don't want to eat... we won't eat...!" Li Dakui waved his hand.

It's too expensive to have breakfast here. It's cheaper to eat breakfast at home.

"Don't eat?"

"If you don't eat, I'll pay for the table, two cents, hurry up!" the proprietress urged, looking at Li Qingshu and others.

"What?"

"This table costs two cents?"

After the lady boss finished speaking, Li Dakui jumped out and said.

"Why, it can't work?"

"If you don't give me the money today, don't even think about leaving. Send them all to the police!"

The owner of the breakfast shop came out with a kitchen knife, looking fierce, glaring at Li Dakui and Li Laotun.

"Dad, you smashed this table into pieces."

"Look, can you solve it?"

Li Dakui frowned and looked at his father.

"Hmph!"

"Isn't it just...isn't it just two cents...!"

Li Laotun looked at the fierce-looking boss, but in the end he didn't dare to stab him in front of outsiders. After all, it was he who smashed the table into pieces.

I had to take out the two cents I planned to buy meat for today and gave it to the proprietress.

Pork now costs 40 cents a pound.

I originally planned to buy half a catty and go back to satisfy my craving. After all, I was so greedy by Li Qingshan’s family last night that I almost couldn’t sleep, but I never thought...!!

Such a thing actually happened?

"Comrade Xu, it's not okay for you to eat tofu every day. Look at your body, why are you so thin?"

"Come on, meat buns, eat more!"

Li Qingshan no longer paid attention to Li Laotun and the others at the next table. Instead, he picked up a meat bun and stuffed it into Xu Wanyin next to him. Then he called to the big two and his father: 'Eat, eat them all, you're welcome...!'’

"Hey!"

Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang nodded, unable to contain their inner expectations, they quickly picked up the meat buns and started to eat them.

Li Qingshan was naturally not polite either.

As he ate it with big mouthfuls, the meat juices burst out in his mouth, the aroma was extremely delicious, and the aroma of the meat spread to all directions.

Next table.

Ye San got up early in the morning and traveled for an hour. He hadn't eaten anything. Looking at the meat buns and fried dough sticks that Li Qingshan was eating, his stomach began to growl.

His eyes kept glancing towards Li Qingshan.

fragrant!!

It smells so good!!

At this moment, Li Qingshu and Li Dakui were like ants on a hot pot, eager to run over and snatch the meat buns to eat.

"Eat, let them eat!"

"With that little money, sooner or later they will be ruined. When they are ruined, sooner or later they will come to beg us."

Li Laotun said.

‘Dad is right, let them be arrogant for a while now, sooner or later they will come to beg us.’ Mr. Li Dakui nodded solemnly, firmly convinced of this.

Li Qingshu couldn't help but curse in his heart.

Old guy, why don't you take pictures of the table when you have nothing to do? Otherwise, with these two cents, you can at least cover breakfast for three people, right?

Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang, and Dad ate six steamed buns, three fried dough sticks, and five bowls of porridge. They couldn't eat any more and their stomachs were bulging.

This breakfast stall is so honest, the steamed buns and fried dough sticks are huge.

Xu Wanyin ate a steamed bun and a bowl of porridge, and finally looked at the fried dough sticks handed over by Li Qingshan and had no choice but to eat them.

Now he was rubbing his belly and looking at Li Qingshan with an aggrieved look.

As for the remaining four fried dough sticks, five steamed buns, and two bowls of porridge, Li Qingshan dealt with them all by himself.

The Da Zhuang brothers, dad, and Xu Wanyin were all dumbfounded.

Is this too delicious?

However, being able to eat well is a blessing!!

"Well, seventy percent full!"

Li Qingshan touched his belly and said.

Now that I practice health-preserving boxing, I need a lot of food every day to replenish my energy. These are steamed bun skins and fried dough sticks, which are all carbohydrates and not much protein. I am indeed 70% full.

I will do a set of health-preserving boxing later, and I will consume almost all of it.

Li Dakui and Li Qingshu at the next table were staring at Li Qingshan and Li Sankui with eyes that could kill.

"Are you all full?" Li Qingshan asked.

"Well, I'm full!"

Da Zhuang and others nodded.

"Lady boss, four more steamed buns and four fried dough sticks!" Li Qingshan shouted.

"What?"

"Qingshan, aren't you full yet?"

Li Sankui had a look of surprise on his face and looked Li Qingshan up and down.

It seems that my son was not so good at eating before.

Why have you eaten so much in the past two days?

"My mother and sister-in-law haven't eaten yet at home. Let's bring some back to them." Li Qingshan said.

"Oh, this...I forgot about this."

Li Sankui scratched his head, a look of embarrassment flashed across his face.

"You little comrade, you are quite filial!" The lady boss quickly wrapped the buns and fried dough sticks, handed them to Li Qingshan and said, "I just don't know if I love my wife!!"

"What's wrong, does the boss lady have any sisters at home?"

"If there is one, introduce her to me. Then you will know whether I love my wife or not."

Li Qingshan said with a smile.

"Okay!"

"When you come next time, I will introduce you!"

After the lady boss took the money from Li Qingshan, she slipped it on the back of Li Qingshan's hand. She was so weak and boneless, and her charming eyes looked at Li Qingshan again, which was still heart-warming.

Damn it, little Lang Hoozi.

Sooner or later it will be done for her.

Li Qingshan swallowed his saliva and said: "Dad, the township government hasn't opened yet, let's sit here and rest for a while!"

"Yeah!"

Li Sankui nodded in agreement.

Li Qingshan took advantage of this free time and went to the open space next to him to perform a set of health-preserving boxing. The dragon's tendons were fierce and the morning sun fell on him. The small gourd jade pendant on his chest gave off a faint brilliance, seeming to absorb the power of the morning sun.

Xu Wanyin originally planned to take a rest and then leave. After all, he ate too much and was a little overwhelmed.

But seeing how powerful Li Qingshan's boxing skills were, he forgot to go to work.

The proprietress who was making breakfast also looked at Li Qingshan, with a flash of desire for the young man's body in her charming eyes.

Thinking of the hole in his house, he felt like a dead pig at night.

Then there was a hint of resentment in his heart.

This guy is so nice...!!

After doing a set of health-preserving punches, Li Qingshan felt that the food in his stomach was almost digested, so he walked over.

"Comrade Qingshan, what kind of punch did you just hit? How powerful?" Xu Wanyin stared at Li Qingshan with a pair of melancholy eyes, but at this moment, he was shining with a strange light.

"Oh, just practice for a while!" Li Qingshan said modestly.

"Oh, it's broken. I have to go to work quickly." At this moment, Xu Wanyin suddenly remembered something and stood up quickly.

"Where does Miss Xu work? Why did she get there so early?" Li Qingshan asked curiously.

It's only six o'clock in the morning. Isn't it too early to go to work?

"We are a supply and marketing cooperative in Tuxiang. I just arrived and I need to get familiar with it in advance, so I arrived early!"

"After I get familiar with it, I'll go to work at 7:30."

Xu Wanyin said.

"So you work in a supply and marketing cooperative?" Li Qingshan asked slightly surprised.

"Yes!"

"What's wrong?"

Xu Wanyin nodded.

"I was planning to go to the supply and marketing cooperative to purchase some supplies, but the supply and marketing cooperative hasn't opened yet, so I'm waiting here."

Li Qingshan said.

"So that's it!"

"You helped me today, let me help you again!"

"Come on, follow me to the supply and marketing cooperative!"

Xu Wanyin said.
